result.lastError: Dispatch input was written and submitted, but the agent's turn start could not be verified during observation (up to 30s). This is unverifiable, not proof the worker is dead: the agent may still be starting, may be wedged (for example waiting on network), or may be holding the task unsent in its composer. If the worker recovers and reports, this Dispatch settles normally.
